name: hindsight
one_liner: A memory system you plug into an AI agent so it actually remembers past conversations and decisions instead of starting from zero every time you open a new chat.
buyer: A founder building an AI customer-support or coding-assistant product who is tired of users complaining the bot 're-asks the same questions' every session.
business_use_cases: A customer-support SaaS bolts this on so its AI agent remembers a specific customer's past tickets and preferences across months, not just one chat.
An indie developer's AI coding assistant remembers a client's codebase conventions and past decisions between work sessions without re-explaining every time.
An AI tutoring app remembers what a student already struggled with last week and adapts today's lesson instead of restarting cold.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted memory API and charge per active agent or per GB stored.
Offer paid integration support to wire it into an existing product's AI stack.

steal_this: Wrap it around an existing AI coding assistant this weekend so it remembers one specific client's project between sessions, and sell that as a 'never repeat yourself again' add-on.
